mapper.sql: select distinct r.role_id, r.app_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.menu_check_strictly, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.dingtalk_enabled, r.dingtalk_access_token, r.dingtalk_secret, r.dingtalk_webhook_url from vpn_role r left join vpn_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join vpn_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.del_flag = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId} and (u.app_id is null or u.app_id = '' or r.app_id = u.app_id)

select r.role_id from vpn_role r inner join vpn_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id inner join vpn_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and r.del_flag = '0' and (u.app_id is null or u.app_id = '' or r.app_id = u.app_id)
WHERE r.del_flag = '0' and u.user_name = #{userName} and u.del_flag = '0' and (u.app_id is null or u.app_id = '' or r.app_id = u.app_id)
